claudeSoundAlerts.enabled.description: Enable the local listener and sound alerts.

claudeSoundAlerts.serverPort.description: Starting localhost port for dynamic listeners. Each VS Code window automatically uses the first free port from this value upward.

claudeSoundAlerts.listenerPortCount.description: Number of localhost ports available for simultaneous VS Code listener instances. Each window automatically picks a free port.

claudeSoundAlerts.debounceMs.description: Suppress duplicate alerts of the same type inside this time window.

claudeSoundAlerts.showVisualNotification.description: Also show a VS Code information notification when an alert fires.

claudeSoundAlerts.eventSettings.description: Per-event alert settings managed by the Claude Sound Alerts control panel.

claudeSoundAlerts.watchedFiles.description: Literal filenames to watch for Claude Code FileChanged alerts, for example .env or package.json. Installed hooks are updated automatically when this changes.

claudeSoundAlerts.repeatGapMs.description: Pause in milliseconds between repeated alert sounds.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Alerts work, but workspace-affinity routing is limited when folders are not local file-system paths.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/review2.js && node test/review3.js
